Title: UQuestObjectiveFloatCounter
Overview:
A premade QuestObjective that counts to a threshhold to complete. NOTE: This premade QuestObjective automatically saves all data needed for the class to function. If you require saving additional information there are two options:
  • Store the data on the SharedQuestDataObject and handle saving within that class.
  • Follow the save system guide for saving in derived classes that already implement save and load functionality (QuestObjectives are their own SaveAgent).
